{{Quote|I'm ambassador to the Supreme Chancellor. I'm taking these people to Coruscant.|Jedi Master Qui-Gon Jinn to a B1 battle droid|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
An '''ambassador''' was a diplomatic official accredited to a government, or to an international organization, to serve as the official representative of his or her own government. While the specific powers and duties of ambassadors varied across governments, planets and eras, they typically oversaw any embassy functions, staff and property, and as such were afforded diplomatic immunity. Sometimes when the diplomatic mission was too dangerous, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] were sent in their place, because of their negotiation skills. In the often turbulent times of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], ambassadors played an important role in facilitating cessations of hostilities or expansions of friendly relationships. Ambassadors were also another name for members of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial ambassador to Rhamsis Callo|ambassador]] to [[Rhamsis Callo]] was the highest-ranking official on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], overseeing relations with the native [[Schenor]]. After learning of an Imperial [[Massacre at the Schenor research station|assault]] on a [[Schenor research station]], [[nest-guildmaster]] [[B'karitz]] confronted the ambassador and declared the [[Schenor/Imperial treaty]] null and void.<ref name="Witness" />

An Alliance [[Unidentified Alliance ambassador|ambassador]] met with the [[Gaddrian ambassador]] aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Silver Star]]''. The Gaddrian ambassador was the head of a [[Imperial Senate/Legends|senatorial]] faction sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]], and the meeting was to discuss the possibility of establishing a fifth column within the Empire.<ref name="Luxury" />
